passages.title: Actual projected model and lower variance normalization
passages.route_note: Native one/two projections of the actual sum plus rectangular Gaussian factor. The pair covariance premise is the actual [[v,vρ],[vρ,v]], which follows by projection from isotropic covariance. c>0 arbitrary; upper variance unnecessary; b absorbed into projected coordinate envelope. This layer does not claim the ambient-to-projection moment constructor, owned by the G3/model adapter.

passages.route_note: Quantitative coordinate adaptation: retain original two face projections, integrate on a square, and display ν by completing the correlated Gaussian form. This is the same characteristic-function strategy, without explicitly constructing q; no lower ambient eigenvalue is imposed.

passages.title: Nonnegative compact-frequency square kernel and probability bound
passages.route_note: The sinc-squared kernel is defined by the norm square of its uniform character average. Actual complex Fubini exposes two independent frequencies and their difference; no density or Fourier inversion assumption. The separate closed-form sine identity and triangular density are not proved because this direct Fubini calculation proves exactly the needed kernel comparison.
